name: Remnant Incense Guide - Snowgrave
desc:
Gathering three pieces of the Remnant Incense Guide - Snowgrave allows you to unseal the vault of Shadow Realm at the Snowgrave.
Legend has it that early squads exploring the Shadow Realm would occasionally find themselves unable to retrieve the treasures they discovered. In such cases, they would leave a specific "scent trail" behind. Only by piecing together the incense trail can one track down the locations of these long-lost relics.

value.text: Recommendation: Found in White Birch Snowgrave
